title: Host gates for the electrical programmer and retained cold filter charge
scope: Align host ownership oracles with already committed circuit contracts; retain every existing assertion family, sample count and numeric tolerance. Legacy physical-unit behavior is unchanged.

limits.parameter_roundtrip_abs: Existing max(0.0001, parameter span * 0.00001); discrete choices use host legal-value snapping.

truth_boundary: Memory/PANEL electrical accuracy remains governed by the existing independent full MemoryPanelNetwork gates and their unchanged programmer-integration.json limits.

Host envelope timing uses independent primitive Adsr/FilterEnv histories driven by a fresh stateless programmer compilation from independently selected APVTS PANEL/memory values, never Engine cached tones or envelope targets. This is an ownership/integration gate, not another absolute circuit calibration.
Factory envelope target/time expectations remain the original independent raw-cell/declared-hypothesis oracle.
The committed cold IL law selects a released drive without replacing capacitor charge. A first strike preserves that cold or pre-ticked charge; Legacy retains its historical reset-to-IL rule.

PANEL/memory now own electrical receiver readouts after a factory-tab exit. Compare with a fresh selected-source receiver calculation using observed envelope/touch inputs; stale factory caches or zero readouts cannot pass.
Meter and unmetered core receive the same electrical ControlFrame contract before any samples; telemetry must remain byte-inert.
P_chorusTabs is a five-choice host parameter and must use legal discrete values in the physical-unit roundtrip oracle.
mutation_requirements: Drop electrical programmer annotation from the processor: metered/core identity and live programmer timing/receiver ownership must reject.
Ignore selected-memory edits or route the wrong bank: live timing and selected-source ownership must reject.
Restore assignment-time filter reset to IL: the retained-charge first-tick oracle must reject.
Treat P_chorusTabs as continuous in the roundtrip oracle: the existing physical-unit tolerance must reject its fractional illegal values.
release_gates: Run the same failing host tests focused, then full unchanged --self-test.
No tolerance, assertion family, scenario or existing test is removed to obtain green.
Record the original 385-failure log and every mutation/restoration result.
